task_message:
Case M18: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 260x260x290 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. Summary:

- **Target:** T2-hyperintense myxoid soft-tissue tumor in the posterior thigh, appearing as an elongated, well-circumscribed bright mass on fat-suppressed T2.
- **Approach:** Located the lesion on axial/sagittal survey sheets, seeded it with a single positive point on the brightest part (axial 165), then verified the resulting mask in all three orthogonal planes and at both ends.
- **Verification:** The mask spans axial 104–225 (≈120 mm craniocaudal), 32 mm AP, 43 mm ML, one connected component, 62.6 mL. Review panels 8 mm past each end showed no residual lesion tissue; outlines conform to the mass in axial, coronal and sagittal views. Thin beaded bright lines inferior to the mass were judged to be vessels (discontinuous/separate in adjacent planes) and excluded. No automatic candidate corrections were proposed.
- **Final confidence:** high.
